title: Lanes
description: Native exported counters and local service health. Token panels are native-client telemetry, not estimates of savings. Cache/reasoning subsets must not be added again. Synthetic acceptance alerts are explicitly labeled. Raw prompt/tool bodies are omitted upstream by the collector.

options.content: Native result records, hcom status and request usage for **1 h / 24 h**. Identity is Codex conversation ID or Claude session ID. The hcom table maps registered roots; child identities stay separate until their native parent mapping is qualified. Missing identity, exposure, export or status freshness is **UNKNOWN**. A zero inventory row means no result record was visible; it proves organic non-use only after exposure and full-window coverage are qualified. Outer code-mode wrappers are tool rows, and are not additional MCP calls. Started user turns are not completed turns. Claude Skill calls and Codex read-command observations are separate contracts. Input, output and cache counters remain separate; provider/cache totals are not summed. [Token layer](/d/token-layer) · [Native telemetry](/d/ecosystem-native)

panels.title: Latest recorded hcom status and root-name lookup
panels.description: Recorded status JSON from hcom list; registry roots missing from hcom remain unknown. Observation time and native status age are separate. Inspect observation time: an old active record is historical, not live liveness. Automatic freshness masking remains open.

panels.title: Per-session started turns and tool result records
panels.description: Started turns and result rows only; completed-turn counts require native completion evidence. Use the hcom root-name lookup above. Descendants remain separate rows.

panels.title: Per-session shells, RTK prefix share and Claude skills
panels.description: exec_command only; write_stdin is not another command. RTK prefix is not hook firing/rewrite. Claude RTK-first and Codex SKILL.md read counts remain unknown in this live stream; the native-record baseline keeps those separate, rather than inferring them from MCP calls.

targets.expr: sum by (identity) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex-app-server|codex_exec|codex_cli_rs"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | label_format identity=conversation_id | tool_name="exec_command" [${window}]))

sum by (identity) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex-app-server|codex_exec|codex_cli_rs"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | label_format identity=conversation_id | tool_name="exec_command" | shell_rtk="true" [${window}]))

100 * (sum by (identity) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex-app-server|codex_exec|codex_cli_rs"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | label_format identity=conversation_id | tool_name="exec_command" | shell_rtk="true" [${window}]))) / (sum by (identity) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex-app-server|codex_exec|codex_cli_rs"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | label_format identity=conversation_id | tool_name="exec_command" | shell_rtk=~"true|false" [${window}])))
targets.legendFormat: Codex RTK prefix % of classified shells

targets.expr: sum by (identity) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | label_format identity=session_id | tool_name="Bash" [${window}]))
sum by (identity) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | label_format identity=session_id | tool_name="Skill" [${window}]))

panels.title: Per-session native tools
panels.description: Each native named result row; no static JavaScript or code-carrier references are counted.

panels.title: Per-session MCP server and tool results
panels.description: Native MCP names, including plugin aliases, retained verbatim. Failed results remain results.

targets.expr: sum by (identity,mcp_server_name,mcp_tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex-app-server|codex_exec|codex_cli_rs"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | label_format identity=conversation_id | mcp_server_name!="" [${window}]))
sum by (identity,mcp_server_name,mcp_tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | label_format identity=session_id | mcp_server_name!="" [${window}]))

panels.title: Codex request usage by native conversation
panels.description: Native response.completed request counters; cache is a subset of input. Not an organic savings claim.

targets.expr: sum by (identity) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex-app-server|codex_exec|codex_cli_rs"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | label_format identity=conversation_id | event_kind="response.completed" | unwrap input_token_count | __error__="" [${window}]))

sum by (identity) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex-app-server|codex_exec|codex_cli_rs"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | label_format identity=conversation_id | event_kind="response.completed" | unwrap output_token_count | __error__="" [${window}]))

sum by (identity) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"codex-app-server|codex_exec|codex_cli_rs"} | event_name="codex.sse_event" | label_format identity=conversation_id | event_kind="response.completed" | unwrap cached_token_count | __error__="" [${window}]))

panels.title: Claude request usage by native session
panels.description: Native API request accounting. Do not add cache categories to another inclusive token total.

targets.expr: sum by (identity) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | label_format identity=session_id  | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [${window}]))
sum by (identity) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | label_format identity=session_id  | unwrap output_tokens | __error__="" [${window}]))
sum by (identity) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | label_format identity=session_id  | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [${window}]))
sum by (identity) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | label_format identity=session_id  | unwrap cache_creation_tokens | __error__="" [${window}]))

panels.title: Native API errors and rate limits
panels.description: Native error records only. Missing rate-limit headroom is UNKNOWN; client status-line configuration is owned by the command center.

panels.title: Native hook results by source and hook name
panels.description: Native source and hook attributes retained by collector step 6. A hook row proves RTK only when its identity names RTK; a plural hooks counter alone does not.

panels.title: MCP connections and compaction
panels.description: Connection transitions and compactions are not tool invocations. Names require collector step 6 read-back; absent metadata stays unknown.

panels.title: Backends up
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health; this is not coverage of every user unit.

panels.title: Gateway health — waits on collector step 6
panels.description: Only the model-free health route is probed. Native http_url label observed on existing targets. Gateway settings and database routes are excluded.

panels.title: Collector streams against limit
panels.description: Watch the 8,000 review threshold against the configured 10,000 stream limit.

panels.title: Codex tokens — lower bound until step 7 read-back
panels.description: Start-timestamp ingestion still needs deployed flag and a newly born single-turn series read-back. Never add this total to Loki usage.

panels.title: Host CPU — collector observed sample
panels.description: Native hostmetrics sample; no GPU or clock-offset coverage is implied.

panels.title: Host memory — collector observed sample
panels.description: Native hostmetrics sample. Unit health, clock and GPU collectors remain separately owned gates.

options.content: **UNKNOWN / pending:** effective per-role tool exposure and exact organic prompt exclusions; Claude RTK rewrites and Codex skill loads; GitHub newest-complete snapshot (step 12, github-ci-finalize); unit failures (alerting PR and lm-qmd); GPU exporter (vllm-embed owner); clock offset; SDK task attribution and gateway optional OTLP span sink (CC environment and restart). OmniRoute v3.8.51 already ships an optional GenAI OTLP trace sink; no claim that it lacks export until v3.9. A newly wired zero-call tool remains unmeasured until exposure and a complete 24 h organic window are qualified.
